name: witch hazel
uses: Uses • Temporarily relieves these external symptoms associated with hemorrhoids: • Itching • burning • irritation Directions As a hemorrhoidal treatment for adults: • When practical, cleanse the affected area with mild soap and warm water and rinse thoroughly. • Gently dry by patting or blotting with toilet tissue or soft cloth before applying. • Gently apply to the affected area by patting and then discard. Children under 12 years of age: Consult a doctor
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if • Rectal bleeding occurs or; • If condition worsens or does not improve within 7 days
